notes: Stranded Citizen Recovery: travel whose destination contains an operational charger no longer requires an additional post-arrival return-energy margin. A critically low citizen who still has enough energy to physically reach that charger may now make the trip and arrive on fumes, then autonomous daily-rhythm logic prioritizes charging. Trips away from charging keep the normal safety reserve. This fixes the deadlock observed with Iri at Resin Grove on 6% energy without teleporting or rewriting citizen position.
